### Summary of Last 35 Emails in Mailpit

- **Jira Notification:**  
  - **From:** jira@enterprise.local  
  - **Subject:** [PROJ-4821] Ticket assigned: Fix null pointer in invoice batch processor  
  - **Date:** 2026-10-02T11:28:53Z  
  - **Content:** Maria was assigned to fix a NullPointerException in the nightly invoice batch job due to missing `billing_address` field. The fix PR is due by 2025-07-11.

- **Product & CX (Alice Chen):**  
  - **From:** a.chen@enterprise.local  
  - **Subject:** All-hands follow-up: action items from Sept 5 session  
  - **Date:** 2026-10-02T11:28:09Z  
  - **Content:** Reminder of action items from the Sept 5 All-Hands meeting, including due dates for an accessibility audit, customer feedback synthesis, internal style guide update, and PTO carry-over policy.

- **GitHub Notification:**  
  - **From:** notifications@github.com  
  - **Subject:** [enterprise/checkout-service] Issue #891 assigned to you: Pagination cursor drift on /v2/orders  
  - **Date:** 2026-10-02T11:28:53Z  
  - **Content:** Jira issue assigned to Tomás N. for pagination cursor drift on the /v2/orders API endpoint, with a suggested fix using a composite cursor and server-side validation.

- **Project Meridian (Tomás Ramírez):**  
  - **From:** t.ramirez@enterprise.local  
  - **Subject:** Project Meridian beta – customer synthesis due Sept 28  
  - **Date:** 2026-10-02T11:28:09Z  
  - **Content:** Reminder to summarize customer feedback for Project Meridian due Sept 28, along with the compliance badge verification.

- **Wingtip Toys (Derek Partnerships Manager):**  
  - **From:** partnerships@wingtiptoys.com  
  - **Subject:** FW: Q4 co-marketing calendar – proposed flight dates  
  - **Date:** 2026-10-02T11:28:09Z  
  - **Content:** Co-marketing plan for Q4 including blog post, co-branded landing page, and paid media flights, with asset delivery deadline of Oct 20.

- **Enterprise Security Policy Update:**  
  - **From:** security.policy@enterprise.local  
  - **Subject:** [Action Required] 2025 Security Policy Update – Mandatory Acknowledgment by Aug 1  
  - **Date:** 2026-10-02T11:31:37Z  
  - **Content:** New security policy mandates MFA, AES-256 encryption, and stricter vendor access token validity and reporting timelines.

- **IT Security Engineering (Sofia Vasquez):**  
  - **From:** it-security@enterprise.local  
  - **Subject:** FW: New MFA Enforcement – Service Accounts (Policy SEC-2025-014)  
  - **Date:** 2026-10-02T11:31:37Z  
  - **Content:** MFA enforcement for all service accounts used in CI/CD, IaC, and deployment pipelines starting from Aug 15.

- **Senior Procurement Analyst (Marisol Torres):**  
  - **From:** m.torres@enterprise.local  
  - **Subject:** RE: Invoice #LI-2024-0847 – Project Falcon – Disputed Line Item  
  - **Date:** 2026-10-02T11:30:45Z  
  - **Content:** Invoice LI-2024-0847 has a disputed line item due to billing exceeding the 96-hour cap in the signed SOW.

- **Monitoring Alert (PagerDuty):**  
  - **From:** monitoring@enterprise.local  
  - **Subject:** [CRITICAL] prod-redis-03 – Memory usage at 94.2% (threshold: 90%)  
  - **Date:** 2026-10-02T11:28:53Z  
  - **Content:** Critical memory usage alert for prod-redis-03 at 94.2%, recommending immediate action to prevent service degradation.

- **Procurement Analyst (Daniel Reyes):**  
  - **From:** d.reyes@enterprise.local  
  - **Subject:** Approved: $42k tooling spend – Jira + Confluence renewal  
  - **Date:** 2026-10-02T11:28:09Z  
  - **Content:** Approval for Jira and Confluence renewal, with PO processing instructions.

- **Platform Engineering (Rafael Novak):**  
  - **From:** r.novak@enterprise.local  
  - **Subject:** API deprecation: /v1/batch-export endpoint – migration notes  
  - **Date:** 2026-10-02T11:28:09Z  
  - **Content:** Notice for API deprecation of /v1/batch-export with instructions to migrate to the v2 endpoint.

- **Integration Lead (Fabrikam):**  
  - **From:** tom.reyes@fabrikam.com  
  - **Subject:** FW: Billing discrepancy on Fabrikam account – Ticket CS-2025-5108 (P3)  
  - **Date:** 2026-10-02T11:30:00Z  
  - **Content:** Inquiry about the discrepancy in billing for excess calls, requesting raw gateway counters for reconciliation.

- **VP, People & Org Design (Maria Okafor):**  
  - **From:** m.okafor@enterprise.local  
  - **Subject:** Org Restructuring Effective Oct 1 – Please Review Updated Chart  
  - **Date:** 2026-10-02T11:28:09Z  
  - **Content:** Announcement of organizational restructuring with new roles and reporting lines effective October 1.

- **Enterprise Support (Maria Solano):**  
  - **From:** maria.solano@fabrikam.com  
  - **Subject:** Question about API rate limits – Ticket CS-2025-3312 (Severity: P2)  
  - **Date:** 2026-10-02T11:30:00Z  
  - **Content:** Inquiry about recent throttling issues on the /v2/ingest endpoint, asking for confirmation on rate limit changes.
